description: Packages whose resolved version in package-lock.json is relevant to a hardware-wallet or Bitcoin signing/PSBT compatibility claim. scripts/ci/hardware-compatibility-report.ts hashes only these packages (by every packages[] path, including nested copies) into source.signingDependencySha256. An unrelated dependency bump must never change that digest; a bump of one of these packages must always force a re-pin. Evidence for each entry: direct imports under src/services/hardwareWallet/** (including bitbox02-api and the bs58check xpub/address codec), server/src/services/bitcoin/**, the QR/BC-UR decoding path (src/hooks/qr/**, src/utils/urPsbt.ts, src/utils/urDeviceDecoder.ts), and the sdk sections of config/ledger-emulator/proof.json, config/trezor-emulator-proof.json, and config/jade-emulator-proof.json.
